methodologyMarkdown:
## Overview
UN News — SDGs is the topic-scoped RSS 2.0 feed of the United Nations news service (news.un.org) filtered to the Sustainable Development Goals desk. It tracks progress, financing and events tied to the 2030 Agenda across the 17 Goals, including the High-Level Political Forum and voluntary national reviews.

## Search
Client-side keyword filtering over RSS item title/description; no server query API. The feed URL scopes content to the SDGs on the server side; any finer keyword match (a specific Goal, indicator or country) must be applied in-memory as a substring scan over each item's title and description.

## Filters
Topic scoping to the SDGs is fixed by the feed URL. Beyond that only client-side filters apply: publication date range (from pubDate) and keyword. Items carry no per-item `<category>`/`dc:subject` tags, so individual Goals cannot be filtered server-side — do so client-side by keyword.

## Download
The retrievable document is the item `<link>` HTML article page. Each item also has an `<enclosure>` pointing to a JPEG lead image, not a PDF; no direct document downloads are offered.

## Metadata & Enrichment
Not supported.

## Limitations
Feed returns only the most recent ~30 items; no historical pagination beyond the feed window and no archive parameter.
probeNotes: Reachable, valid RSS 2.0. Observed 30 items. Fields: title, link, description, guid, pubDate, enclosure (JPEG ~44KB). No <category>/dc:subject tags. No PDF links.
